landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to really learn
landing.f1d: Play a single verse, repeat it, slow it down, or loop a whole passage.
landing.f2d: Every word lights up as it is recited, with transliteration and meaning.
landing.f3d: Read the classical commentary for the verse you are listening to, with sources.
landing.f4d: Hide words, recite from memory and let spaced repetition tell you what to review today.
landing.f5d: Big colors, simple buttons and star rewards – learning that children enjoy.
landing.f6d: German, English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Chinese, Indonesian and Persian.
landing.s1d: Pick a surah and play it verse by verse with your favorite reciter.
landing.s2d: Open the tafsir and the word-by-word meaning right next to the verse.
landing.s3d: Practice from memory and come back when the app says a verse is due.
landing.footer: Quran text, translations and tafsir via Quran.com · Recitations via EveryAyah
